sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Charger for the Ops Phone is faulty — unable to recharge properly. Battery life at 22%.
Welfare check along Starbucks, all clear.
Patrolling down Queen Street ensuring our presence is visible.
Arrived at the corner of Queen and Wyndham Street; area thoroughly checked, no issues to report.
Arrived at the corner of Queen and Shortland Street, no issues found. Continuing patrols down Queen Street.
Welfare check inside Imperial Lane, floor checks completed. No vagrants identified.
Checked in at Commercial Bay, full sweep completed; checked into McDonald's Britomart, Hollywood Bakery and 77 Convenience Store, all clear.
Standby to show presence and await further response calls and incidents.
Continuing patrols due to no activities concerning our assistance.
Checked in at Queens Wharf, scoping the area for any possible vagrants or issues, none found.
Arrived at check-in corner of Customs and Albert Street intersection, no issues found.
Welfare check along Albert Mart Convenience Store and Discount Dairy, all clear.
Welfare check along Federal Square and The Cathedral Church, area thoroughly cleared, no issues found.
Welfare check along Good To Go Supermarket, Hollywood Bakery and Chemist Warehouse, all clear.
Welfare check along Little Albert's Cafe, The People's Barista, Formery and Sky Mart Convenience Store, all clear.
Checked in at top of Victoria Street; welfare checks along all stores, no issues found. Follow-up check at Amelia's Cafe, all clear.
Standby to show presence and await response calls and incidents.
Continuing patrols due to no concerns identified. Patrolling up Federal Street.
Arrived at the corner of Federal and Wellesley Street; scoped out Auckland Council Building, all clear.
Welfare check along convenience store on Cook Street, all clear.
Arrived at last checkpoint for Alpha Route, Aotea Square; full walkthrough completed, no issues found. Standby to show presence.
Checked in at top of Mayoral Drive, full scope of the area, no issues to report.
Welfare check inside Queens Food Court and other nearby stores, all clear.
Welfare check along Auckland Library, all clear.
Arrived at check-in corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street, no issues found. No response calls or issues visible so far.
Welfare check completed along Lorne Street stores and businesses, all clear.
Welfare check along High Street stores and businesses, all clear.

Response call from City Garden Hotel reporting a break-in and a group of disorderly individuals causing trouble around 10pm–11pm, setting off the fire alarm at the residents' carpark. Requesting a check-up tonight.
Message forwarded to Night Shift and Afternoon Shift.
Welfare check along Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall, all clear.
Checked in at Chancery Square, full sweep completed, no issues found. Standing by to show presence while awaiting further response calls.
Continuing patrols due to no activities concerning our assistance. No response calls and no incidents identified so far.
Welfare check completed along Vulcan Lane and O'Connell Lane, all clear.
Checked in at Wilson's Carpark Fort St; checked in with static guards, no reports made; checked all stores and businesses within the area, all clear.
Checked in at bottom of Fort Street; welfare checks along all stores and businesses, no issues found, no reports raised.
Standby to show presence while awaiting further response calls.
Arrived at checkpoint for Echo Route — Kiwibank, corner of Commerce and Customs Street; checked in with static guard, all clear. Welfare checks on all nearby stores.
Checked in at Commercial Bay, full walkthrough completed. Standby to show presence while awaiting further response calls.
No issues to report; continuing standby to ensure presence is known.
Continuing patrols due to no activities concerning our assistance.
Welfare check along Aotea Gifts and Metro Woolworths, all clear.
Checked in at corner of Customs and Albert Street intersection, area thoroughly checked, no issues found. Patrolling up Queen Street.
Arrived at the corner of Wyndham and Albert Street intersection; checked all stores in the area, all clear.
Checked in at top of Victoria Street; welfare check on all stores and businesses, all clear. Brief standby before continuing patrols.
Continuing patrols due to no issues identified.
Welfare check inside Crowne Plaza Hotel, making our way down towards Atrium on Elliott, no issues.
Checked in at Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street; checked in on static guards, all clear, while grabbing some drinks.
Arrived at HQ; standby for a quick restroom and meal break.
Standby to recharge the Ops Phone due to low battery life.
No issues or concerns arisen; continuing standby for further response calls and incidents while preparing for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.
Equipment handover: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio. Ops Phone charger still faulty; battery life at 10%.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Debrief with morning shift regarding the status of the CBD.
Debrief completed; suiting up for deployment and patrols.
Checked in at corner of Victoria St East and Queen Street (HQ). Welfare check, all clear:
Checked in at Skyworld Entertainment Center and Aotea Square, full sweep around the area. All clear.
Welfare check and walkthrough of Bledisloe Building alleyway behind Skyworld Entertainment Center. All clear.
Checked in at Commercial Bay, full sweep around the area. All clear.
Ending Alpha Route here and commencing Delta Route.
Checked in at Commercial Bay. All clear.
Welfare check through Fort Lane and Snickel Lane and stores within both vicinities. All clear.
Checked in at corner of Fort Street and Fort Lane. All clear.
Welfare check on stores along lower towards upper Queen Street, all clear:
Response call from Cotton On regarding a female individual stealing handbags, last seen heading into Darby Street.
Arrived at the last-seen direction the individual was heading towards.
Swept through Darby and Elliott Street and middle Queen Street, no signs of the individual described.
Standing by to show presence; the individual who stole has been sighted in the city and is known for stealing (photo on file).
Leaving standby and commencing routes again.
Haus of Gelato Cafe Wellesley Street West
Checked in at corner of Wellesley Street East and Lorne St. All clear.
Welfare check through Auckland Library. All clear.
Heading back to Headquarters to conduct mandatory building sweep.
Building check completed; commencing routes again.
Checked in at corner of Rutland St and Wakefield St. All clear.
Checked in at Auckland Town Hall. All clear.
Tanuki Japanese Sake and Sushi Bar
Response call from Cotton On — they have spotted the individual who stole earlier sitting inside McDonald's Queen Street.
Arrived at the response call and retrieved the items back.
Items returned to Cotton On (photo on file); standing by to show presence and ensure she causes no further trouble before moving along.
Most stores are closed now; conducting welfare checks on stores still open for late trading.
Checked in at Aotea Square. All clear. Ending Delta Route and commencing Echo Route.
Walkthrough from corner of Wellesley St and Federal Street towards Victoria St West. All clear.
Checked in at corner of Victoria St West and Federal St. All clear.
Response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding a female individual drinking inside the female bathrooms and refusing to leave. Assistance requested.
Arrived at the response call; staff notified us the individual had left the premises. Standing by to show presence.
Leaving standby and resuming welfare checks around the area.
Welfare check Mövenpick Hotel. All clear.
Welfare check Q Convenience Store. All clear.
Welfare check sweep through Wilson Carpark Fort Street. All clear.
Response call from Choolaah container regarding a female individual standing behind their containers.
Arrived at the response call, spoke to the female individual and she complied (photo/video on file).
Lunch break completed; standing by for changeover to the Night Shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:45)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Debrief with afternoon shift completed. No issues reported during handover. Gearing up and commencing patrol along upper Queen Street.
Still patrolling Queen Street, no issues to report. Welfare check conducted at McDonald's Queen Street, no issues.
Full sweep from McDonald's Queen Street to the Civic Theatre completed, no issues. Proceeding towards Aotea Square.
Full sweep of Aotea Square completed, area clear. Welfare check on local security completed, no issues. Continuing patrol towards Elliott Street.
Patrol from Aotea Square to Elliott Street completed, no issues. Continuing patrol to Victoria.
Darby St sweep complete, no issues; arriving at Victoria St.
Welfare check conducted on 77 Convenience, area clear. Heading towards the Cathedral Church.
Response call from McDonald's Britomart regarding vagrants outside the venue causing a disturbance; putting patrol on hold and making our way now.
Arrived at the venue; as we arrived police also arrived. Standing by in case assistance is needed, no further issues.
Situation sorted; standing down from McDonald's Britomart, no issues. Resuming patrol.
Standing by 77 Convenience; group of delinquents outside causing disturbances (photo/video on file).
